scope: Public MINOS at-limit presentation and export semantics

result.at_limit_semantics: Preserve the raw signed bound distance and flags; label the value as distance-to-limit rather than a statistical uncertainty.
result.closed_interval_semantics: Both finite, valid, non-limit Delta-FCN crossings are required.
result.plot_semantics: At-limit and invalid sides are omitted from confidence whiskers.
result.serialization_semantics: Raw values and parameter-limit flags round-trip; older payloads default missing limit flags to false.

network_note: Two online Pkg.test attempts stopped before test execution on TLS handshake failures. The complete test target was then resolved from installed compatible packages and executed with Pkg.offline(true).
